name: Plan my day
description: Fits your to-dos into your free time. A draft for tomorrow every evening; nothing goes in your calendar until you approve it.

settings.label: Bot that writes your calendar
settings.help: Its grokdash id. It redoes the plan when you write a note, and adds the blocks once you approve.

settings.label: Draft tomorrow at
settings.help: HH:MM. If you don't use that draft, a new one for the rest of the day comes in the morning.

settings.label: Day starts
settings.help: HH:MM. Nothing is placed before this.

settings.label: Day ends
settings.help: HH:MM. Nothing is placed after this.

settings.label: Break between blocks
settings.help: Minutes, also kept around calendar events.
